study_identification_part.si_4_title: Brain morphology normative modelling platform for abnormality and centile estimation: Brain MoNoCle

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilizes a total of 14 distinct datasets for normative model training (N=3,276 healthy controls) as listed in Table S1.1: ADHD1000, BLISS, CamCAN, Chronotype, Greene-HM, HCP, MEGUK, NCL-dementia, NIMH-IHV, NKI, OASIS3, Stanford-CR, and UCLH. For clinical validation, it uses the IDEAS (mTLE) and BLISS (BD) datasets.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: We collated 3T T1-weighted MRI scans from 3,276 healthy individuals from several large public and in-house datasets, detailed in Supplementary Materials S1... To demonstrate the utility... we included two exemplar clinical datasets... IDEAS... BLISS
